summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader without running any code. Changes: new monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and private helper _resolve_path (stdlib os/json only); explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py; "Decathalon DataLoader" subsection after the Utilities automodule in docs/source/data.rst; new tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist covering the four specified cases, each removing its temp directory in a finally block. Line lengths were measured with awk: none exceed 120. Black and flake8 were not run, and the tests were not executed, so they are unverified. Nothing is committed. Choices made where the spec was silent: absent image/label keys are skipped; a non-list data_list_key value raises ValueError; malformed JSON is re-raised as ValueError naming the file; non-mapping top-level JSON is reported as a missing key.
